correctness.rationale: PASS: Strong next false at final position makes precisely n-1 monotone clauses (-r_i or d_i or d_{i+1}). A set of locks guarantees satisfaction iff it hits the set of true literals of every clause: if a clause has no locked true literal, its three atoms can consistently be flipped to make it false, because every occurrence of an atom has a consistent polarity. Minimal locks are exactly minimal transversals of the clause-edge hypergraph; minimal unlock sets permitting a failure are inclusion-minimal true-literal clause edges. Every full-edge vertex lies in some minimal transversal (private r witness or delivery with private other clauses), so deleting any true vertex strictly reduces count; the all-true-literal valuation uniquely maximizes modulo unused final r. For each delivery selection binary b_j, private request literals are precisely at 00 adjacent pairs; indispensability of delivery forbids 111 and endpoint 11. Four-state transfer gives Tribonacci 3,5,9..., all sizes floor(n/2)..n-1 and four largest-size explanations for n>=3; CXps are n-1 distinct three-element edges. Independently enumerated lock/transversal sets for small n and inspected verifier; analytic hypergraph proof is all-length.

It demonstrates sharp exponential growth of minimal sufficient explanations on a single compliant trace versus linearly many minimal interventions, exposing a concrete explainability enumeration bottleneck without scaling the formula or alphabet. Complete finite-length count, precise maximizers and size distribution are useful standalone invariants; not falsely claiming discovery of Tribonacci numbers.

final_claim: For strong-next finite-trace formula G((X true and r)->(d or X d)) on a fixed 2-atom alphabet, length n>=2, the maximum number of subset-minimal satisfaction AXps is A2=3,A3=5,A4=9 and Tribonacci thereafter, uniquely attained by two traces: all deliveries true and all nonfinal requests false, final request arbitrary. The full AXp size polynomial is a binary-word transfer over words avoiding 111 and endpoint 11; CXps number at most n-1 and exactly n-1 three-literal clauses at the maximizers.
limitations: Strong next and fixed n crucial; final r is irrelevant; excludes violation-side extremum and arbitrary formulas.
